lemma_statement: [CommRing A][TopologicalSpace A][PlusSubring A][IsTopologicalRing A][IsHuberRing A][T2Space A][NonarchimedeanRing A] (𝔪:Ideal A)[𝔪.IsMaximal](¬IsOpen 𝔪) : ∃ v ∈ Spa A A⁺, v.supp = 𝔪
b2_reason: FALSE for bare PlusSubring: A⁺=⊤ (the whole ring) is a valid Subring/PlusSubring instance, and in a Tate ring Spa(A,⊤)=∅ (tnu unit ϖ forces v(ϖ⁻¹)>1, violating v(A⁺)≤1), so no v with supp=𝔪 exists. Hypotheses do not entail the conclusion; the missing hypothesis is the ring-of-integral-elements property A⁺⊆A° (the reviewer/user-flagged PlusSubring API change). CORRECTION to the existing docstring: the claim that the exact form needs the rank-1 domination theorem is WRONG for a MAXIMAL ideal — exact-for-maximal follows from the AXIOM-CLEAN containment exists_spa_point_supp_ge_maxIdeal_of_complete (𝔪≤supp v) plus maximality (supp v is prime ⊊ A, 𝔪 maximal ⟹ supp v=𝔪). The only real gap is A⁺⊆A°.
counterexample: A=ℚ_p (complete Tate field), A⁺=⊤, 𝔪=(0) [maximal, non-open since ℚ_p non-discrete]: Spa(ℚ_p,⊤)=∅, so no Spa point with supp=(0)

b2_reason: FALSE after the faithful IntCl redefinition completedPlusSubring = Ĉ = closure(image of (A⁺[T/s])^int): the integral closure escapes the A₀-based ring of definition, so Ĉ ⊄ ringOfDef. Deleting it is correct. BUT this exposed the real scope: it produced the vestigial B⁺⊆B₀ hypothesis threaded as `hplus` through the ENTIRE acyclicity engine; de-threading it (faithful) terminates at StandardCover.spanTop_iff_noCommonZero_spa → exists_spa_point_with_supp_ge_of_prime, which is pair-based and needs a pair-free [IsRingOfIntegralElements (A⁺)] form with NO base-level instance — i.e. the reviewer foundational interface change + an 8-file pair→pair-free migration (the documented P1 marathon #58-61), NOT the ticket's stated 5-user re-route.
